Build kit for "saml login"

Start from the TEMPLATE, fill it with BLOCKS, and use COMPONENTS only for what is left.
Changing a page you already have? Keep it, and use only the blocks and components.

TEMPLATE
Search matched `login-sso` by name, but this template fits more of the idea. Scaffold it, then replace its content. Keep its layout and spacing.

name:        login
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Minimal centered credential form on a plain ground: two fields and a submit, nothing competing for attention.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template login --type page <path>

Install missing dependencies: npm install @heroicons/react@"^2.2.0"

OTHER TEMPLATES
If the layout is wrong, scaffold one of these instead. All page templates: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template --list --type page

name:        login-sso
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Progressive credential flow that branches on input: the email domain resolves an identity provider and redirects, with a password path as fallback.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template login-sso --type page <path>

name:        login-card
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Credential form inside an elevated centered card, third-party provider buttons separated from the fields by a divider, secondary sign-up and legal links beneath.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template login-card --type page <path>

Keyword search matched these page templates: login-sso (@astryxdesign/core), login (@astryxdesign/core), login-card (@astryxdesign/core).

COMPONENTS
For what the template and blocks do not cover. Read one: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component <name>

frame:      AppShell, TopNav, SideNav, Layout
foundation: VStack, HStack, Grid, StackItem, Card, Section, Text, Heading, Button, Icon, Badge, Divider
